Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:109724
Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12271 of 2023
Applicant :- Guddu
Opposite Party :- State Of Up And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Manish Kumar Kashyap,V.P. Singh Kashyap

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant-accused, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2. None has appeared on behalf of informant despite service of notice.

3. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in case crime No.261 of 2022,
under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, police station Dataganj, District Budaun with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
4. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant-accused that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.

The informant has lodged first information Guddu vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13631489/
1 report of this case on 31.05.2022, alleging that on 23.05.2022 applicant has enticed away the minor daughter of informant.

entities.text: Guddu vs State Of Up And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In her statement under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., victim has not made any allegation of kidnapping or of rape against applicant.

In her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C.,
victim has stated that she has married with applicant and they have resided together as husband and wife and her age is about seventeen and a half years.

In her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.,
victim has stated that she has gone with applicant to Punjab with her own free will and that she remained there for two months.
In her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she has not made any allegation of rape or of physical relations against applicant.
Victim has refused for her medical examination.
It was submitted that the ossification test of victim has not been conducted and in fact she is major girl and even as per school record, she is aged about seventeen and a half years.

Lastly,
it has been submitted that the applicant-accused is languishing in jail since 07.09.2022, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant-accused is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
5.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

7. Let the applicant-accused Guddu involved in aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
(i) The applicant-accused shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii) The applicant-accused shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
(iii) The applicant-accused shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
(iv) The applicant-accused shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

(v) The applicant-accused shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement,
threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
8.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant-accused in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 19.5.2023 Neeraj  Guddu vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13631489/
2
